notes: The selected main feature always receives the canonical movie name, including when an old canonical filename belongs to an extra.

Explicit theatrical, extended, director, final, uncut and unrated cuts remain features rather than being classified as extras by duration alone. Theatrical is preferred explicitly, with stable duration, size and path fallback.
Preparation records and preserves the selected main cut across retries. Adds enumeration-order, filename-collision, alternate-cut and repeat-preparation regressions.
